_comment: Automation Website settings - CARD-ONLY operation: every posting limit lives inside a card in data/cards.json (posts per day, posts per run, interval hours+minutes, fixed times, posting window, topic, bold). There are no global posting settings any more. paused=true stops all automation (this file is paused right now - set false only when you want the worker to run). dry_run=true = test mode, nothing is posted. blogger_enabled / bsky_enabled / replies_enabled / cards_enabled = master safety switches (a card never runs when its workflow is OFF). blogger_bold_format = default bold formatting for Blogger articles (each card can override). card_default_* = defaults a new card starts with. Keys and passwords stay in GitHub Secrets, never here.
